messages.subject: separate fill scales for margins?
parts:
Hi,

How can you vary fill gradients for margins separately?

Starting with the following...

tst.melt <-

structure(list(beg = structure(c(4L, 4L, 4L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 2L,
2L, 2L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 4L, 3L, 2L, 1L), .Label = c("total", "c",
"b", "a"), class = "factor"), end = structure(c(1L, 2L, 3L, 1L,
2L, 3L, 1L, 2L, 3L, 1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 4L, 4L, 4L), .Label = c("a",
"b", "c", "total"), class = "factor"), Freq = c(30L, 20L, 10L,
15L, 25L, 10L, 11L, 13L, 20L, 56L, 58L, 40L, 60L, 50L, 44L, 154L
)), .Names = c("beg", "end", "Freq"), row.names = c(NA, -16L), class = "data.frame")

ggplot( tst.melt,aes(end,beg)) +
geom_tile( aes(colour=Freq,fill=Freq,width=7),alpha=.4)+
opts( axis.line=theme_blank()
      ,axis.ticks=theme_blank(),strip.background=theme_blank()
     ,legend.position="none",axis.text.x=theme_blank()
     ,axis.title.x=theme_blank(),title="Ending PD")+
labs( y="Beginning PD")+
facet_grid( .~end,drop=FALSE,scales="free")

Thanks very much!
